repos_data.description: Open-source, local-first social media research agent for Instagram, TikTok, and LinkedIn. Jev routes read-only steps; socai CLI captures cited browser evidence.
Reliable research infrastructure for AI agents. Evidence-backed web search with citations, confidence scores, and Clarity anti-hallucination. MCP server, REST API, Python SDK.
Give your agent the web as real sources, never made-up answers — an MCP server with 15 search and 9 extract providers plus an optional local, key-free DonSeTch integration.
